title: Oozing Smoky Uruguayan Rice Pilaf
description: A silky, smoky rice pilaf with caramelized flavors, cooked in a claypot for a velvety finish and a touch of indulgence.
instructions: Rinse 1 cup of short-grain white rice until water runs clear and drain.
Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a claypot over medium heat and sauté 1 chopped onion until translucent.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, and 1/2 teaspoon cumin, stirring for one minute.
Stir in 1 cup vegetable broth, 1 tablespoon tomato paste, and 1 tablespoon caramelized brown sugar, bringing to a low boil.
Add the rinsed rice, reduce heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove the pot from heat, let it sit covered for 10 minutes to absorb liquid and become velvety.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro.
Serve hot, optionally garnishing with a drizzle of extra olive oil and a sprinkle of smoked paprika.
